description: End-to-end workflow for managing unified communications subscriptions, tracking usage, rating and billing, and processing payments for B2B telco customers.

account_id.description: Unique identifier for the B2B customer account

tenant_id.description: Identifier for the UC tenant/workspace within an account

subscription_id.description: Identifier for a UC subscription bundle

user_id.description: Identifier for an end user within a tenant

usage_session_id.description: Identifier for a single usage session (call, meeting, message batch)

usage_batch_id.description: Identifier for a batch of usage records imported together

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP)

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: create_uc_account
functions.description: Create a new B2B unified communications account and primary tenant.

primary_domain.description: Primary SIP or UC domain for the tenant

tags.description: Freeform key-value tags for the account

functions.returns: Newly created account_id and primary tenant_id with initial configuration summary.

functions.name: configure_uc_subscription
functions.description: Create or update unified communications subscription plans for an account tenant.

subscription_name.description: Human-readable name for the subscription bundle

bundles.description: List of bundled services and allowances

overage_rate.description: Overage rating per modality in account currency

status.description: Desired status of the subscription configuration

functions.returns: subscription_id and full subscription configuration details.

functions.name: list_tenant_users
functions.description: List users provisioned under a tenant with their UC service entitlements.
functions.returns: Paged list of users with user_id, contact info, and UC entitlements.

functions.name: ingest_usage_batch
functions.description: Ingest a batch of UC usage records (voice, video, messaging, etc.) for rating and billing.

records.description: Array of raw usage records from network/UC platforms

routing.description: Routing details for voice/contact center usage

raw_charge.description: Optional pre-rated charge from external system

attributes.description: Arbitrary attributes for analytics or rating overrides

tags.description: Batch-level tags for tracking (e.g., source file name)

functions.returns: usage_batch_id, number of accepted/rejected records, and summary of validation errors.

functions.name: validate_usage_batch
functions.description: Run detailed validation on an ingested usage batch and mark records as ready for rating or flagged.
functions.returns: Validation summary with counts by status (valid, corrected, rejected) and error categories.

functions.name: rate_usage_batch
functions.description: Apply rating to validated usage records in a batch and produce rated usage sessions.

re_rate_existing.description: If true, re-rate records that already have charges.

time_zone.description: Time zone to use for time-of-day pricing rules (IANA name).

functions.returns: Count of rated sessions, total rated amount per modality, and list of usage_session_ids with rating status.

functions.name: get_usage_summary
functions.description: Retrieve aggregated usage and charges for a given period by account, tenant, and optional user breakdown.
functions.returns: Aggregated usage metrics and charges by requested group_by dimensions.

functions.name: generate_invoice
functions.description: Generate an invoice for an account for a specific billing period based on rated usage and subscriptions.

cycle_label.description: Display label for the billing cycle, e.g., '2026-01 Monthly'

tax_profile.description: Optional tax override for this invoice

draft.description: If true, generate invoice as draft (not posted).

functions.returns: invoice_id, invoice totals (net, tax, gross), line item breakdowns, and status (draft/posted).

functions.name: get_invoice_details
functions.description: Retrieve full details of an invoice including line items, taxes, and payment status.
functions.returns: Complete invoice object with optional sections as requested by include.

functions.name: process_invoice_payment
functions.description: Process a payment for an invoice using a specified payment method.

amount.description: Amount to pay; if omitted, full outstanding amount will be used.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key to ensure payment is not processed twice.

functions.returns: payment_id, updated invoice balance/status, and payment gateway status.

functions.name: get_payment_status
functions.description: Retrieve the status and details of a specific payment transaction.
functions.returns: Current payment status, timestamps, reconciliation info, and optional gateway metadata.

functions.name: retry_payment
functions.description: Retry a failed or pending payment transaction with optional adjustments to method or amount.

override_payment_method.description: Optionally override original payment method for retry.

amount.description: If set, overrides original payment amount.

surcharge.description: Additional fee to apply on retry, if applicable.

functions.returns: New or updated payment_id with latest status and any error codes if retry failed.

functions.name: cancel_or_rollback_invoice
functions.description: Cancel an invoice and optionally rollback associated rated usage and payments for error recovery.

mode.description: Determines whether to only cancel, cancel with credit note, or rollback rating and usage.

rollback_options.description: Additional controls when performing full rollback.

credit_note.description: Credit note configuration when mode is cancel_and_credit.

functions.returns: Confirmation of invoice cancellation/rollback, optional credit_note_id, and list of impacted payments and usage batches.

functions.name: search_uc_billing_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across uc_billing entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching uc_billing entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_uc_billing_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N uc_billing records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_uc_billing_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many uc_billing records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_uc_billing_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many uc_billing records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_uc_billing_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of uc_billing data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_uc_billing_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a uc_billing dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_uc_billing_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more uc_billing entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_uc_billing_snapshot
functions.description: Restore uc_billing state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_uc_billing_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the uc_billing workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_uc_billing_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across uc_billing metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_uc_billing_audit_events
functions.description: Search the uc_billing audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_uc_billing_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers uc_billing workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_uc_billing_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for uc_billing events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_uc_billing_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for uc_billing events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_uc_billing_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off uc_billing job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_uc_billing_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled uc_billing jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_uc_billing_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled uc_billing job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_uc_billing_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a uc_billing operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_uc_billing_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a uc_billing action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_uc_billing_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a uc_billing approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_uc_billing_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any uc_billing entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_uc_billing_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a uc_billing entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_uc_billing_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling uc_billing behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_uc_billing_policies
functions.description: List uc_billing policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_uc_billing_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two uc_billing-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_uc_billing_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a uc_billing entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_uc_billing_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many uc_billing entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.
